subject: Competitive bake-off recap and next steps — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Li <david.li@acmehealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap and next steps — Acme Health

Hi David / Priya,

Thanks for taking the time today — good to meet the team. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed plan for the bake-off so we stay aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes on peak clinical-search workloads (95th pct > 800ms)
- Cost per query increasing with bursty traffic and multi-region failover
- Need for per-route observability and audit logs for compliance

Goals you want to achieve with a vendor:
1) Consistent <200ms 95th latency for standard patient search flows
2) 40% reduction in per-query inference cost vs current provider at scale
3) Full auditability and retention controls for HIPAA-ready workflows

Competitive criteria we discussed:
- Latency & throughput under load
- Cost per token/embedding at scale
- Security controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs)
- Rollout controls and fallback behavior
- Support responsiveness / SLA

Proposed bake-off plan (attached: bakeoff-test-plan.xlsx):
- Week 1: Provision test environment (Redwood dedicated pool) + baseline run vs incumbent
- Week 2: Focused latency/throughput tests (synthetic and replay of recent traffic)
- Week 3: Functional checks (auditing, logging, failover) + final summary

Deliverables from Redwood:
- Short demo recording showing traffic shaping & fallback (redwood-bakeoff-demo.mp4)
- Test-plan and scripts (attached)
- SLA summary & proposed trial pricing (see attached PDF)

Open questions for your side:
- Who will own the traffic replay data and can you share a 24-48 hour sample?
- Any sensitive test vectors we should avoid in the shared test environment?

Next steps:
- David: confirm the test dataset and availability window for week of Oct 19
- Priya: share procurement checklist / required PO terms if we move to trial
- Ben & Aditya: we will set up credentials + initial dedicated pool by Oct 16

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call if you want to walk through the test plan together.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: David Li <david.li@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap and next steps — Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap and thanks for the fast follow. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Dataset: We can share a redacted 48-hour replay of our search logs (will coordinate via S3 link). Expect it by EOD Wednesday (Oct 14).
2) Security: For the bake-off we need the test env to sit inside our VPC with customer-managed keys (KMS) — please confirm this is possible for the trial.
3) Success criteria: In addition to latency and cost, our engineering leadership wants a short report on inference determinism and tokenization differences vs incumbent provider.

Also, a couple of constraints from procurement: we need a trial agreement / MSA addendum signed that limits PI exposure and clarifies data deletion after test. Priya will loop in procurement.

If Redwood can spin up the environment by Oct 16 as you suggested, great — we'll aim to start tests Oct 19.

-David

David Li
Director, Engineering
Acme Health
david.li@acmehealth.com | (212) 555-9876

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Li <david.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap and next steps — Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — procurement here. Two asks to keep the trial moving: 

1) Please send a short trial addendum that clarifies: data handling, deletion timeline (we require deletion within 30 days of test completion), and liability caps for trial data.
2) A point of contact for technical onboarding and SLA questions (name/email/phone).

Can Ben be the named contact for onboarding? If so, please also include his calendar link for scheduling.

Best,
Priya
Procurement Manager
Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>, David Li <david.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap and next steps — Acme Health

Hi Priya / David — happy to be the onboarding contact. Quick answers: 

- Trial addendum: attaching a 2-page trial addendum template that covers data handling, 30-day deletion, and limited liability. We can sign an NDA or addendum as needed.
- Onboarding contact: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai) | +1 (415) 555-0199. You can book time here: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/redwood-onboarding
- VPC + KMS: Aditya (cc'd) will confirm the exact setup but we support customer-managed KMS and can provision a VPC peering path for the test pool.

Action items from Redwood:
- Ben / Aditya: provision test credentials and share S3 upload target for replay data by Oct 16
- Marissa: prepare trial pricing summary and SLA that we discussed

Attached: redwood-trial-addendum-template.pdf

Thanks,

Great — appreciate the quick responses and scope alignment. Short status update: 

- We received the S3 replay link this morning and the team verified the sample (thanks David).
- Ben & Aditya have started provisioning the dedicated test pool; credentials expected by EOD Oct 16.
- I attached the bake-off test plan and the short trial addendum; Priya, please confirm if the addendum meets procurement's needs or if you want edits.

Proposed checkpoint call: Friday, Oct 16 at 11:00am PT to confirm environment and test schedule — Ben will send calendar invite.

If anything changes, ping me directly. Looking forward to running this and showing concrete numbers vs your incumbent.

Best,

Marissa Cole
